rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3BA label and identifies a loose ICM and good TE, but it overstates image-visible certainty (e.g., fully expanded blastocoel occupying most of the embryo, precise clock-face localization) and calls stage 3 'expanded' rather than full blastocyst/early expansion terminology.
Integrates age, ovarian response, sperm parameters, endometrium, BMI, first-cycle status, and lifestyle with embryo quality in a clinically meaningful way, though some links are somewhat speculative.

The logic is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible probability estimate tied to age and morphology; minor issues include overconfident morphology interpretation and some unsupported quantitative adjustments.

Most recommendations are broadly evidence-based (eSET, luteal support, age-related counseling), but suggesting ERA after multiple failures and co-culture/time-lapse to improve selection is not strongly guideline-supported, and routine assisted hatching here is questionable.
Provides clear next steps for transfer, follow-up, and contingency planning, including eSET and future-cycle considerations, though a few recommendations are more optional/speculative than standard.
